value.rationale: Finite chore-inventory size is a natural known planning parameter. Its exact minimax ratio is a parity staircase, attaining 7/6 on four or five chores versus only asymptotically approaching 5/4, and is not inferred from the published uniform guarantee. The necessary-and-sufficient pairwise-design characterization identifies precisely which correlations determine robustness. For power-of-two costly supports, a near-support-minimal affine design reduces possible random outputs from exponentially many balanced subsets to 2(t-1), motivating practical low-randomness implementation.
